text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Reaching the top"—through her first three years,
Verxina fulfilled that dream.
She became an older sister her younger siblings could be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet it wasn't just her younger sisters who were drawn
to her dazzling, gentle radiance anymore—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
Verxina-san, Trainer-san!
Thank you for guiding us today!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "On the contrary, thank you very much for bringing five people together."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I must tell you in advance:
even if this is just a trial, I will not go easy on you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
For all of you about to plunge
into the brutal world of racing from here on...
I shall train you to the absolute limit!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Aiming for the Top
text_block_list.text:
I-I would gladly take you up on that...!
Because I want to stand at the top, just like you, Verxina-san!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, by all means, try to chase after me.
—After this back of mine!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the sight of Verxina's confident nobility,
the Umamusume's eyes...
sparkled with admiration.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—Come on! One more lap!
When you're tired is when you give it everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Strength for the sake of someone else, huh?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —You there.

text_block_list.name: Refined Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!
Ah, m-me?!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You've been watching me all along, haven't you?
As if trying to steal my techniques.

text_block_list.name: Refined Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ……I-I am terribly sorry――

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That would hardly be an efficient way to learn, would it?
Come over here.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Be hammered, be crushed, and grow stronger.
—Are you prepared?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, and one more thing.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"You would do well to treasure your rivals.
—For that, too, is a source of strength."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... It looks like Gentildonna-san
is in the middle of giving instruction too.
choice_data_list: Maybe I've been influenced by you or something
Maybe I've just been influenced by you or something.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
My, that is simply impossible.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...No, allow me to correct myself.
Perhaps that truly is the case.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I, too... am a "strong" Umamusume
meant to accomplish great deeds.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Yes, Verxina had... a major undertaking awaiting her. That was—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Phew...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Just a little.
If I win today—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Because it would be the first consecutive victory in history,
something no one has ever accomplished before."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Verxina, it would be her second Victoria Mile...
She is taking on the challenge of achieving
the first-ever consecutive victory in its history.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Today's strategy is to take the lead from the start and run away with it, isn't it?
...Are you feeling nervous at all?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"If those trailing behind put on an incredible burst of speed,
and on top of that, I lose my own momentum—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh, why is that?
choice_data_list: Her strength is her fighting spirit to strike back even after being overtaken, right?
Her strength is her fighting spirit to strike back even after being overtaken, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
Yes, that is correct.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
In front of their watching eyes,
I will never show such a pathetic display again!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall be on my way.
—Please believe in me and wait!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking the lead just as planned, Verxina
raced along at a brisk pace as if guiding the other Umamusume,
and on the final straight—

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
“—If I'm gonna make my move, it's now!
Hyaaaaaaaah!!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Yet this development was
precisely what she had hoped for. Surrounded
and flanked by the other Umamusume, Verxina...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, I won't yield!
This radiance belongs to me alone—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
This is the brilliance of the pinnacle I have to show them...!
Haaaaaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...!!
She's re-accelerating...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Verxina holds on! Verxina holds on!
Can Verxina achieve the first back-to-back victory in history?!
Verxina! Verxina!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
—Go, sis, gooo!
—Big sisteeeer!!
—Verxina~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Verxina wins back-to-back titles!
Verxina holds on!
An unprecedented back-to-back victory!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—Haa!
We did it, everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I really did it. I won back-to-back.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right! Isn't she amazing, Big Sis!
It feels like she's pulling further and further away...

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh? She won't grow distant.
Because she will always,
always be part of our family.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Big sister... will always be big sister.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
And even if... that means
suffering lies ahead...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"—'I wish I wasn't her sister.'
...I'm sure she'd never think that."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Obviously~ ♡
Because——

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
The absolute best
big sister in the world! ♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(So those girls can forge ahead without straying,
I will continue to stand at the pinnacle.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (Even if I fall from there—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(With you, with everyone dear to me...
and with the fighting spirit residing in my heart,
I can stand back up no matter how many times it takes.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No matter what expectations or admiration you hold...
I shall accept them all at the peak.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm—
the big sister!"
